programmes.d: A voice trumpet sounds while the Teletubbies sleep; a lion and bear come to Teletubbyland.
The Teletubbies play a sitting and standing game. They watch some children who are sitting and standing too. Po is riding on her scooter. She hasn’t gone very far when she finds Dipsy’s hat.
Noo-Noo drives fast; children make a salad; dancing bear on the carousel.

Dipsy has no time for Tubby Custard, before watching a little girl help feed her baby sister. Po makes some Tubby Custard for Dipsy, but every time she comes to the table, she forgets and eats it all herself.
The Teletubbies watch two boys make Chinese Lanterns with their uncle.

The Teletubbies and some children learn about the colour blue. In Teletubbyland Po is watching the blue sky when it begins to rain. She finds a blue puddle and is delighted when she sees her reflection.
Po is hiding. She comes out to watch a little boy playing crazy golf. In Teletubbyland the Teletubbies are playing a hiding game.
Children learn about all things green; the Teletubbies pick Dipsy as their favorite green thing.
The Teletubbies enjoy a big hug before watching a lady tell a story about four friends. She uses her hands to make actions to tell the story.
The Teletubbies and some children learn about the colour blue.
Andy Brown and some children watch some badgers. In Teletubbyland, Dipsy sat down to watch. He watched the windmill turning, the rabbits playing, and the trees in the wind.
Natalie tells the Teletubbies about her brother's christening; magic cloud.
The Teletubbies love dancing. They watch a group of children perform the Boom Boom Dance, to some drum music.
The Teletubbies watch Sarah and Mark give their sheep a winter-feed.
The Teletubbies dance in and out of the trees. The Teletubbies watch Matthew, James and Mark feeding their chickens. There's toast all over Teletubbyland when the Tubby Toaster makes too much toast.
The Teletubbies watch boys spin some special spinning tops to celebrate Hanukah.
A balloon appears in Teletubbyland; it floats in the air. The Teletubbies follow the balloon all over Teletubbyland, but they can't catch it.
The Teletubbies dance; Yvette washes her plastic cups and saucers; messy day.
The Tubbies watch some children build towers of different shapes and sizes. Laa-Laa and Dipsy play an up and down game. They take turns to sit down and stand up, then they go up and down the slide.
The Teletubbies are asleep, but Noo-Noo tidies up their blankets.
The Teletubbies dance round the Dome, but stop to watch Zoe collect some things in her Treasure Box for her sister Sophie. In Teletubbyland, Dipsy hears magical music and sees a cloud.

The Teletubbies watch some children go for a ride on a Sea Tractor. Po goes for a ride on her scooter, while she’s riding she sees Laa-Laa’s ball, Dipsy’s hat and Tinky Winky’s bag. They’ve left them all behind!
A voice trumpet rises to tell the Teletubbies 'Christmas is a Coming'.
The Tubbies play a bumping bottoms game. They stop to watch some children play some ball games. Laa-Laa’s ball goes in a puddle, she tries to get it back but can’t reach it.
The Teletubbies watch some children making Christmas cards.
The Teletubbies watch some children go on a boat trip to see some seals. Tinky Winky is wondering what everyone is doing.
Two children are making Christmas crackers for each other.
The Teletubbies are very, very happy. They watch two boys make Chinese Lanterns with their uncle. In Teletubbyland, it is time for Tubby Toast, but where has Laa-Laa's toast gone?
The Teletubbies follow Tinky Winky's star all over Teletubbyland.
Andy Brown and some two children look for fox cubs. Tinky Winky falls asleep in bed, Dipsy falls asleep at the table, Laa-Laa falls asleep on the slide and Po falls asleep on the scooter.
A voice trumpet appears and teaches the Teletubbies a winter nursery rhyme.

Teletubbies love dancing, but they love children even more. So everything stops when they watch some children painting in a most unusual way. Back at the house, a trail leads Tinky Winky all around Teletubbyland to find out.
Children visit a level crossing and watch a train; animals march through Teletubbyland.
Dipsy and Laa-Laa are out for a walk and Po is riding her scooter, but where is Tinky Winky? When the other Tubbies see him they chase him all over Teletubbyland.
The farmyard boys feed their cows and calves and watch them grazing in a field. Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Laa-Laa eat their Tubby Toast at the table, and Po eats her toast in her bed.
Slide game; Becky and Jed look for eggs on their farm; the lion and bear play hide-and-seek.
The Teletubbies watch some children playing with torches. In Teletubbyland, Po chases Tinky Winky, and Po catches him.
Alex Pascall and some children sing to their dolls to rock them to sleep

A voice trumpet rises & makes lovely roaring sounds, Dipsy & Laa-Laa laugh and run away. Some children pretend to be different animals and guess what they are. Tinky Winky hears a big roar and runs away.
Tinky Winky doesn't know how to make Tubby Custard.

Po pops up between Dipsy and Tinky Winky. They join Laa-Laa to watch two girls go for a tram ride around San Francisco. Laa-Laa and Po go for a walk. Laa-Laa goes the quick way and Po goes the long way.
Laa-Laa dances with her ball; living in a block of flats; balloon.

The Teletubbies pop up to say hello before they gather round to watch some children learn about the number nine. Po and Tinky Winky count nine flowers that appear in Teletubbyland and then run off to fin Dipsy and Laa-Laa and dance the Bump dance.
The Teletubbies imitate children doing funny walks before attempting funny walks of their own.

The Teletubbies appear one at a time to say ‘Eh-oh’. They watch some children playing with bubbles. It’s time for Tubby Custard. The custard machine makes a funny noise, and a tubby custard bubble comes out followed by more.
The Teletubbies line up to say 'Eh-oh' and then watch Matthew and Mark feed a baby calf.

The Teletubbies watch Daniel and Stephanie make big round pancakes. They are having a round and round day. They run round and round in Teletubbyland, but they stop to see the dancing bear in the Carousel, then there's time for one more dance.
The Teletubbies watch a Spanish girl play her violin for her friends. In Teletubbyland the Teletubbies watch Po dance.
Dipsy's hat keeps blowing away and he has to chase it all over Teletubbyland.
The Teletubbies love to eat Tubby Custard, but Po spills hers on the floor and the Noo-Noo cleans up the mess.
Some children help their dad to wash his car. They get very wet and soapy.
A voice trumpet brings a magical, musical message for Po. The Teletubbies watch two children whose father is a lighthouse keeper, and learn that lighthouses have lots of steps.
The Tubbies crawl through the arch in Home Hill and watch Alex Pascall and some children sing...
A voice trumpet rises to teach Dipsy a nursery rhyme. The Teletubbies watch two children playing with water. It rains in Teletubbyland, and makes a puddle.
The Teletubbies watch some children play with balls of different shapes and sizes.
Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Laa-Laa run into Home Hill to say 'Eh-oh', but where 's Po? Some children help their dad to wash his car. They get very wet and soapy.
It's time for the Teletubbies to exercise; a voice trumpet rises and the Teletubbies stretch.
All the Teletubbies pop up to say hello. The Teletubbies see a girl whose mother is a very good singer. Four happy Teletubbies dance around Teletubbyland.
The Teletubbies watch some children learn about the number two.
A voice trumpet brings a message for Dipsy and Laa-Laa. The Teletubbies watch some children learn about the number two.
The animals march through Teletubbyland.
Noo-Noo tidies up Laa-Laa's ball. The Teletubbies watch some children rolling things up…and down a hill. Po starts all the other Teletubbies rolling through Teletubbyland.
Two girls make a picture of a gold fish pond using tissue paper. Dipsy sees a cloud and decides to follow it. The cloud rains and leaves a puddle.
Amy cooks pasta at home; Noo-Noo cleans up an unraveled ball of string.
Dipsy leaves his hat behind, but when he comes to find it. The Noo-noo has tidied up. The Teletubbies watch some children style their friend Rosie’s hair.
Another story about the Naughty Sock; the Tubby toast machine makes a pile of toast.

In Teletubbyland, the Tubbies are trying to be quiet. They watch Oscar read the story of the Gingerbread Boy to his brother Felix. A voice trumpet appears and sings the nursery rhyme 'Run, run, as fast as you can'.
The Teletubbies watch some children looking at penguins waddling and swimming.
The Teletubbies sit down to eat some Tubby Custard, but they stop to watch some children buy some different sorts of vegetables. The Teletubbies ask the question – what colour is Tubby Custard?
In Teletubbyland, nine pretty flowers and a watering can appear.

The Teletubbies watch some children perform a Maori Song. In Teletubbyland, Po sings a lovely song. Gradually the other Teletubbies join in, until they sing a lovely song together. The Teletubbies love to sing.
The Teletubbies love playing on the slide.
The Teletubbies watch some children wearing their boots and playing in the garden. A pair of boots appears in Teletubbyland.
The Teletubbies learn gymnastic routines from Samira and her friends.

The Teletubbies watch some children mixing water, paint and washing up liquid to make bubble pictures. Po shows us how to make Tubby Custard before running off to watch three ships sail through Teletubbyland.
The number four with Noo Noo; Po draws an oval; black and white; a boy and a girl help milk a cow.

The Teletubbies pop up to say "Eh-oh", and then run off to watch two children go for a ride in a hovercraft. The Teletubbies are very careful not to drop their Tubby blankets on the floor, but if they do, the Noo Noo tidies up.
The Teletubbies watch some children learn about the number two. Dipsy and Laa-Laa are eating Tubby Toast.
Maribel teaches flamenco dancing to two eager students; the Teletubbies wash their feet.

Andy Brown and some children feed some birds and watch them playing on the bird table. In Teletubbyland, it's timer for Tubby Custard, but Dipsy spills his all over a Tubby Seat. No-one wants to sit in the Tubby Custard, so Noo-Noo tidies it up.
The Teletubbies laugh when they make a tune whilst eating their Tubby Custard.

The Teletubbies watch some children who love to skip. In Teletubbyland, the Teletubbies practice skipping. To begin with they’re not very good, but after lots of practice, they skip all over Teletubbyland.
Tinky Winky dance on the roof of Home Hill and wakes up the other Tubbies.
The Teletubbies watch some Spanish children picking chillies. In Teletubbyland the Tubby Toast machine wasn’t working. Tubby Toast flies everywhere.
Dipsy says "Eh-oh" and runs off to find the other Tubbies.

The Teletubbies go up the slide to see two children help mend a dry stone wall. A wall appears in Teletubbyland. Laa-Laa, Po and Tinky Winky play a game with the wall. They hear Dipsy coming and hide behind the wall.
The Tubbies watch a little girl who loves monkeys help her mum feed them in a zoo.
The Teletubbies say eh-oh, then laugh as they fall over. They get up to watch some children have fun playing on a huge pile of cushions.
The Teletubbies are very happy when they find their favourite things to play with.
Teletubbies lobe to play peek-a-boo. The Teletubbies watch some children painting pictures. When a book appears in Teletubbyland, something magic happens when Dipsy turns the pages.
In Teletubbyland, the Tubbies are trying to be quiet.
The Teletubbies watch some children taking photographs of each other's faces. Dipsy has a good look around Teletubbyland when a telescope appears.
Po fetches the other to watch Andy Brown and two children look for some rabbits.
Po jumps out from behind Tinky Winky and they run off to watch Andy Brown and some children looking for creatures. They find some woodlice under a log.
Dancing; children paint pictures and patterns on eggs; magical tree appears.
Alex Pascall and some children sing to their dolls to rock them to sleep. Laa-Laa wants to sing a lovely song to Dipsy and Po, but Tinky Winky is crunching his Tubby Toast too loudly!
Tinky Winky has no time for Tubby Custard before watching some children feed some baby penguins. The Lion & Bear appear in Teletubbyland.
Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Laa-Laa sit down to eat some Tubby Custard.

Boy makes a turban; Dipsy, Po and Laalaa play; Tinky Winky goes for a walk.
Becky goes on a tram ride and has an accident involving Po's scooter.
